label: Figure 7.1
caption: Figure 7.1 The relationship between regulations and guidance in the approved documents
description: Figure 7.1 is titled "The relationship between regulations and guidance in the approved documents." Beneath the title a green square shows "K4" next to the words "Protection against impact with glazing," followed by a larger green heading, "Requirement K4: Protection against impact with glazing." A line of text states that this approved document deals with the following requirement from Part K of Schedule 1 to the Building Regulations 2010. Two dashed-outline boxes then appear, each tagged with a circled number on the right. The first, marked 1, carries a green header "Requirements" and is divided into two columns headed "Requirement" and "Limits on application"; under the first column it gives "Protection against impact with glazing" and the wording of K4 with sub-points (a), (b) and (c), while the second column is left blank. The second box, marked 2, has the green header "Performance" and, after a sentence giving the Secretary of State's view, lists approaches a, b and c. The two boxes are stacked vertically.
